Subject: MAP: Lighthouse Health close calendar & procurement handoff

Thanks for a productive call this morning — quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the MAP and procurement milestones. Attaching draft v1 for reference (see attachment stub).

Key outcomes from today's demo/discovery:
- Lighthouse is prioritizing a HIPAA-adjacent pilot across 3 test clinics (Q3).
- Success metrics: 30% reduce triage time, 2-week mean time-to-onboard for clinicians.
- Primary blocking area: procurement & legal review timeline (procurement expects a consolidated signature window).

Proposed MAP highlights (please confirm owners):
1) Finalize SOW & pricing worksheet — owner: Laura Bennett — target: 2026-07-09
2) Security review response (SOC 2 artifacts) — owner: Karthik Iyer — target: 2026-07-12
3) Legal redlines consolidated and review meeting — owner: Ben Carter (coord w/ LH legal) — target: 2026-07-16
4) Procurement internal approvals + PO issuance — owner: Lighthouse procurement — target: 2026-07-23
5) Contract signature (mutual) — target: 2026-07-20 (we should align legal and procurement)
6) Pilot start (first clinic) — target: 2026-08-03

Notes/risks:
- We proposed a target close (signature) of 2026-07-20 to allow a 2-week procurement lead for PO by 2026-07-23. If legal needs extra time, we should rebase the pilot start accordingly.

Attachments: redwood_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestone table)

Ask: Anna/Michael — can you confirm whether the internal procurement gating requires signature earlier than 7/20, or if PO on 7/23 is workable?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement/legal side: were trying to close before the end of July because our next internal budget committee meets 2026-07-29. Our preferred contract signature date is 2026-07-20 so that procurement can get a PO to finance by 2026-07-23.

- Procurement can escalate to the committee if we have a clean-of-redlines SOW by 2026-07-09.
- If redlines cause substantive change to pricing or deliverables, well need an additional legal meeting — that would push signature into early August.

Ill attach a short procurement checklist (sending separately) and have Michael loop in our contracts lead when we hit the redline consolidation step.

Anna Morales
